steps.subject: sky
steps.action: tap in sky color

steps.subject: sun/glow
steps.action: soft glow with white and yellow ochre
steps.rule: keep amounts tiny so the blue does not turn green

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: tap in light tree shapes
steps.load: almost no paint, picked up from the canvas
steps.rule: pick up what is already there instead of adding more

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint thin limbs and twigs
steps.load: thinned to ink with paint thinner
steps.rule: same color as the trees so they do not stand out

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: soften some tree shapes
steps.rule: softening pushes the trees back so they look farther away

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: dab dark subdued tree and bush shapes
steps.load: dark green darkened with black and a little lavender
steps.rule: keep them quiet so they do not stand out

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: tap in soft grassy area
steps.load: a little green on the brush
steps.where: lower part away from the light
steps.rule: keep it dark and away from the light so it recedes

steps.subject: path
steps.action: paint a winding path with the knife
steps.load: small roll of paint pulled out flat

steps.subject: path
steps.action: soften the path edges

steps.subject: land
steps.action: push a ridge of green along the edge
steps.rule: in front of the path pushes it back; work farthest to nearest

steps.subject: path
steps.action: blend path into the surroundings
steps.rule: brighter back and larger near edge make the path look far

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: drop in a very large dark tree

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: lay highlights on the tree masses
steps.load: small roll of paint on the knife
steps.motion: barely touching and letting it flow down

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: highlight one side of each tree
steps.rule: light comes from the center so both sides get some highlight

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: add blue reflected light on far side
steps.load: tiny bit of blue and white
steps.rule: blue on the far side shows reflected light

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: tap dark brown to blend and form trunks
steps.rule: dark brown lets the colors blend so they look real

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: add grass around the bottoms of the trees

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint thin limbs on the trees
steps.load: thin ink-like brown with a touch of white
steps.rule: a touch of white so the limbs show up

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: dab a few small leaves
steps.load: tiny bit of medium with yellow and green
steps.where: a few spots on the trees
steps.rule: keeps the background from getting lost

steps.action: dab bright red and yellow ochre marks
